doc.method_javadoc:
/**
     * Skips specified number of bytes in the current CPIO entry.
     * 
     * @param n
     *            the number of bytes to skip
     * @return the actual number of bytes skipped
     * @throws IOException
     *             if an I/O error has occurred
     * @throws IllegalArgumentException
     *             if n < 0
     */

siblings.javadoc:
/** * Returns 0 after EOF has reached for the current entry data, otherwise * always return 1. *

* Programs should not count on this method to return the actual number of * bytes that could be read without blocking. * * @return 1 before EOF and 0 after EOF has reached for current entry. * @throws IOException * if an I/O error has occurred or if a CPIO file error has * occurred */
siblings.name: available

siblings.javadoc:
/**
     * Closes the CPIO input stream.
     * 
     * @throws IOException
     *             if an I/O error has occurred
     */
siblings.name: close

siblings.javadoc:
/**
     * Reads the next CPIO file entry and positions stream at the beginning of
     * the entry data.
     * 
     * @return the CPIOArchiveEntry just read
     * @throws IOException
     *             if an I/O error has occurred or if a CPIO file error has
     *             occurred
     */
siblings.name: getNextCPIOEntry

siblings.javadoc:
/**
     * Reads from the current CPIO entry into an array of bytes. Blocks until
     * some input is available.
     * 
     * @param b
     *            the buffer into which the data is read
     * @param off
     *            the start offset of the data
     * @param len
     *            the maximum number of bytes read
     * @return the actual number of bytes read, or -1 if the end of the entry is
     *         reached
     * @throws IOException
     *             if an I/O error has occurred or if a CPIO file error has
     *             occurred
     */
siblings.name: read

siblings.javadoc:
/**
     * Checks if the signature matches one of the following magic values:
     * 
     * Strings:
     *
     * "070701" - MAGIC_NEW
     * "070702" - MAGIC_NEW_CRC
     * "070707" - MAGIC_OLD_ASCII
     * 
     * Octal Binary value:
     * 
     * 070707 - MAGIC_OLD_BINARY (held as a short) = 0x71C7 or 0xC771
     */
siblings.name: matches
